newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia money market rate down 20 bps to 9.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatia money market rate down 20 bps to 9.1 pct.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate eased a further 20 basis points to 9.1 percent on Thursday in thin trade, dealers said.
They said modest demand, totalling 17 million kuna, overshot supply as the banks' accounts after Monday's reserve payment bottomed at the lowest level in the past two weeks.
Only 12 million kuna, mostly call money deals were struck, of which fresh loans accounted for 10 million.
Call money rate were stable at 9.0 percent and one smaller one-week loan was made at 11 percent.
Wednesday's overnight trade also shrank to 4.3 million kuna as no more than two banks borrowed money to square positions.
The central bank's midrates for Friday's dealings eased to 5.3719 kuna to the dollar and 3.5677 against the German mark. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
